t: Participate in killing Glomo and report to Boros the Brazen.

Do you want to know how I became the leader of the Freeborn? I won this right in a fight! Before both me and an ogre named Glomo were always vying for power. The dissension was driving the Freeborn in a bad direction, so we decided to settle our dispute in a fair fight. I won of course!
After that Glomo was driven out of Pridonsk. I hear he went up to the Northern Sand Bar and took over the local group of goblins. Apparently he smashed their former leader with one blow. I hear he's not satisfied with ruling that rabble, so all he does is dream of revenge.
He could pose a threat to Pridonsk in the future, but unfortunately I can't kill him. It would be shameful to finish off a foe that has already admitted defeat. You, however, are free to act. I would be really grateful if you could dispose of him quietly. But make sure you bring friends along - he is a formidable rival.
Do you see this scar on my face? That ugly brute gave it to me. Be careful around him!
Great job! He was always a strong one, but stupid and dull. Pridonsk is better off without him.
Collect 5 Dead Sea Trophies from the most dangerous creatures and return to Anthropologist Shrinka the Forester.

Hey, I know you're a seasoned traveler and all, but the Dead Sea is a very dangerous place!
You let your guard down for one second and that's it! It's all over! I want you to get used to the dangers of a place like this, so I need you to venture out and kill five of the Dead Sea's most dangerous creatures!
But you need to give me proof – a trophy from the likes of Dryfang, Sorokonza, Boneripper, a slate elemental, a sunfire elemental, Sandscreecher, a gigantic sandtalon manticore, Fleshflayer, a desert viper... And so on and so forth...
Well? Have those creatures been defeated?

Excellent!
I knew you could do it. And by defeating these beasts, you now know more about the local fauna.
Kill 75 Lizardmen report back to anthropologist Vladimir Lychkin.

There are a lot of dangers out here but our biggest menace is the lizardmen!
They inhabit the Tangled Knoll, and this is a perfect site for the next resort! It's time to go deal with them to make them more flexible and open to negotiations.
Well? I hope those lizardmen shake with fear every time they hear your name.

Thank you.
Hopefully now we can focus on bigger and better things!
Gather 6 Dead Sea Pearls for Anthropologist Vladimir Lychkin.

Sea pearls! Now that there are so little seas left in the world, pearls have a special value.
This was once a sea... You can still find pearls all over the place, if you look hard enough... But the best places to look are around the skeletons of divers. People would risk their lives diving to the bottom of the sea without any special breathing devices just to look for pearls! Only a few were lucky enough to return... and those who drowned, still have on them the pearls they had collected.
So now that you know where to look, get out there and find me six pearls!
Pearls are all over the Dead Sea, but you'll have the best luck if you look near the skeletons.

Thank you!
This ought to get us some more anthropologists out here! It can get pretty lonely, you know...
Complete all of the Anthropologist's tasks and report back to Vladimir Lychkin.

If you can successfully complete all my tasks, you'll be generously rewarded.
And I'm not talking about some rinky-dink potion! You'll have the knowledge that you've gained from this adventure as well as some prime equipment that's bound to help you on your future journeys!
So, find the stones, defeat the beasts, and gather some valuable resources here in the Dead Sea!
Have you completed all of my tasks?

Wonderful!
You know, I must admit, I didn't think you'd be able to do it. Thank you for proving me wrong! Go ahead and take your reward!
Meet with the Great Imperial Magician Yasker and pass on to him Wrokag's request.

That's it, I'm resolute about this! It's not only my authority that's at stake here, and not only the shamans' authority either. It's the wellbeing of every single Orc in existence! I want to see Skulnar the Fierce! What is this rubbish, anyway - taking an Orc, sending him to some secret laboratory, and not bothering to inform me. It's ridiculous!
I wonder which lab he's in? The sixth? No, that can't be it. There's a thingy in that lab... an aviak! It's for project "Wing". Skulnar can't have anything to do with the aviaks. Maybe it's the ninth? Hmm, that's also doubtful. I hear they're designing Astral-proof clothes over there. Don't tell me... the thirteenth? Oh, no! That's got to be it!
Go to Yasker immediately. Tell him... tell him that I am furious. That the Council has stolen the last of the Legendary Orc's descendants! Yasker will surely know what you're talking about.
Tell him... tell him that if Skulnar doesn't report to me within an hour... I... I will announce that the Orcs are leaving the Empire! Yes! ...Wait! You don't need to tell him that last bit. I was a bit worked up.

Skulnar the Fierce? Wrokag is still hung up on that idea? Oh, it's so hard to deal with him. Now Crazystorm, there's a straightforward Orc that understands everything, does everything properly, and doesn't dream of any independence. Anyway, that's a different story. Now let's talk about Skulnar.
Meet with Elizaveta Rysina and get her to sign your Clearance List.

It's curious that Wrokag wants to see Skulnar right now. A coincidence? An accident? Hm. Well, this how we're going to do this.
Skulnar was sent to Lab Thirteen, a project that is under my personal guidance. It could be said that this is the most important scientific project in the Empire.
Only the most trusted and most discreet have access to information about this project. And I'll be honest with you - you do have a good reputation. Your list of achievements is quite impressive. I'm willing to give the highest level of access, but not straight away.
This decision has to be a joint one. I'm not a dictator after all. You need to get permission from the highest Imperial officials, which of course they will only do if they trust you completely.
First you should meet Rysina, the head of the City Council. Then you need to talk to Negus Kheket, the Head Scientist of the Arisen. Finally you should meet with Wrokag. There's one I'm sure will sign your pass. Here's the clearance list. The next time I see you, there must be three signatures on it or you won't be able to go.
Yes? Do you have something to report?
Permission to access Lab Thirteen? Well, all my dealings with you have been excellent, so I'll be happy to sign your list.
Meet with Negus Kheket and get her to sign your Clearance List.

Now you need to get a signature from Negus Kheket. I'm certain that you won't have any problems. But I guess it's a little hard to predict what she'll do sometimes. I think all those years have warped the Arisens' brains a little.
I'll be honest you with you, I'm so glad that you've decided to look into this business. After you get to Lab Thirteen, maybe you'll be able to tell us what happened there.
I'm sorry, but I can't tell you anything more definite than that - you haven't got all the signatures yet. Once you arrive, I'm sure our agents will be able to fill you in on the whole story.
You're distracting me from important work. Talk quickly!
Lab Thirteen... Well, I'm more than ready to sign this, and for good reason!
Meet with Wrokag the Northwind and get him to sign your Clearance List.

Not everything is going according to plan at Lab Thirteen. And that's putting it mildly! Having some fresh minds to help is a great idea. Ah, what a pity that Nefer Ur has gone to the Holy Land! He would have sorted this out straight away and found explanations for everything.
But he's far away and you're right here, so I suppose you'll have to be the one to help us. Perhaps you'll be able to stop things from getting any worse, at the very least. He's your signature and now you can go talk to Wrokag. I'm sure he'll put his squiggle on the paperwork without any questions.
You're back at last! Well, what did Yasker say?
A signature? What for? Ah, it's a clearance list. Of course I'll sign it, pass it here.
Take the completed Clearance List to Yasker.

Head back to Yasker. You have all the necessary signatures now, so there's nothing to stop you from going to Lab Thirteen.
Hmm, I've never been there myself. Somehow I've never found these strange experiments interesting. There are much more important things to worry about, like the fate of the Orcish race.
Besides, nobody understands anything about the Astral and those demons! Not the League, not the Empire - nobody! And I'm pretty sure that's not gonna change. Why should I get involved in useless work?
Well? What did the officials say?
Alright, all the signatures are present. I didn't expect anything else. Now to add my own, and the list is complete. There! Now we can talk openly.
Give the Clearance List to Roman Mishin in the Bort Quarter to get to Lab Thirteen.

Now I can tell you what Lab Thirteen is all about. Perhaps you have already met some demons in your travels. If so, they were probably just small Astral demons, nothing serious.
But there are other ones, too - powerful, awesome creatures, capable of killing even a Great Mage. Remember that it was these beasts that killed Tensess, the Great Mage of Kania.
Skrakan and Nezeb organized the Great Astral Campaign and closed the June Gates, through which the demons used to come into our world. Many of the creatures perished in that great battle, but some of them survived and still live in the Astral. And they are still powerful, with a power that we have decided to tame.
That is the goal of Lab Thirteen. The best minds in the Empire gathered to carry out incredible experiments that would change the future. And that is just what happened there until recently.
A few days ago we got a report that something was wrong. The lab assistants have succumbed to some kind of madness. Now the doors to the Laboratory are sealed, and nobody can get inside.
If you're going there, find out what happened. I'm certain that Rysina, Kheket, and Northwind all gave you their own orders as well. But your main task is to make sure Lab Thirteen can continue its research.
To get inside the facility, you need to show this clearance list to Roman Mishin, the Portal Keeper in the Bort Quarter. He'll be able to send you there.
Where do you want to go?

Hah! I still remember the time when you didn't even know how to use a portal. Now you're bringing me a clearance list to teleport somewhere top secret! Your career sure is progressing quickly! Just talk to me any time you want to go there and I'll send you on your way.
Go to Lab Thirteen and talk to Mitrofan Semidolin.

I'm sure you'll get permission to go to Lab Thirteen. Once you get there, I have a mission for you. Find Mitrofan Semidolin - he's an agent of the City Council and he has special privileges and authority. In fact, he's the one responsible for the ideological control over the progress of these experiments.
Tell him that you'll be at his full disposal, and then follow whatever orders he gives you. And don't forget to visit me when you come back. I need to know what exactly happened at the lab. Remember, these orders are extremely important and I expect you to carry them out to the best of your ability!
So you're from Rysina? This is excellent! I'm sure you're a competent soldier, or you wouldn't have been given access to this lab at all. And competent helpers are just what we need!
Deliver the Black Stone Shard to Nomarkh Netjerkare.

Let's talk about more important issues now. Recently the workers at the ZIT Headquarters discovered that Tep has found a new body. All that remained in his sarcophagus was a strange black stone.
Strange black shadows have also been sighted in the Dead Sea. They seem to prevent people from resurrecting, and a strange black obelisk was identified as the shadows' source. The composition of the obelisk appears to be the same as the stone found in Tep's sarcophagus.
We started studying the stone immediately, but... we haven't discovered anything. Sometimes there are secrets that even we can't crack.
But there's one more scientist that hasn't tried to solve the mystery yet. He's a brilliant researcher by the name of Nomarkh Netjerkare. He's been away from the ZIT Headquarters for quite some time since he's been studying at Lab Thirteen. I want you to deliver this piece of black stone to him when you get there.
My name is Nomarkh Netjerkare. What can I do for you?
Hm, what is this stone? Please tell me all the details.
Go to Lab Thirteen and talk to Blackhand the Unyielding.

Now let's talk about Skulnar. When you get to Lab Thirteen you must find him as quickly as possible. Do you hear me - you must! From what I can gather, the lab is in complete chaos. That means it will probably be difficult, but that it's even more urgent! Skulnar needs to return to Nezebgrad safely.
I wish I had sent one of my shamans there. It would have been nice to have someone clever to help you that knew what was going on. I suppose your best bet is Blackhand the Unyielding. He's a warrior in the Imperial Sentinels, so that means he's mostly loyal to Crazystorm. He might refuse to help you... but maybe not.
Well, there's no one else to ask so give it a shot. Talk to him and don't hide anything. Give him all the information he needs, even the story about the Legendary Orc and your journeys. If he's a real Orc he'll help you. And if the mangy cur refuses, I'll rip his throat out!
Were you sent by Wrokag? Hm. And what does the Supreme Chief want from me?
Oh please, you are no psionicist. You're just a weird shaman.
That's right, put these strange ideas out of your head and focus on finding the real descendant of the Legendary Orc.
Bring shards of the Tears of the Dragon to Yulia Dobrynina in Nezebgrad.
Looks like a slightly opaque crystal, filled with an incredibly strong magic. Better show it to someone who understands.
What can I help you with?

These are tears of the Dragon! They are so large, so rare!..

Dragons were the Keepers of Sarnaut, who died out very long ago. The legends say that the dragons used to mourn their fallen comrades. Their tears reached the ground to freeze into crystals, filled with magic. I shouldn’t know if this is true or not, but what I do know is that they are very useful in combat.

If you have Tears of the Dragon in your locket, your blows and spells will deal much higher damage - at the expense of magic, released from the Tears. As soon as a tear runs out of magic, it burns to ashes. Experienced heroes always carry spare Tears on them.

The purer the tear, the more magic it conceals. I will provide you with a few, but in the future you will have to take care about it yourself.
Order Yaver Yevgini to start building an astral ship, wait until the construction is complete and talk to Nomarkh Hanotep in the astral hangar.

The Astral is deadly to any matter. It dissolves anything it touches without a trace - people, objects, even entire allods! For many years the only way to move between the allods was via portals. It wasn't until recently that we revealed the secret of meteorite iron. Meteorite iron can repel the Astral. Now our ships have a plating that contains extra small particles of meteorite iron, which allows them to plow through the deadly Astral just as easily as boats sail on river waters. And now you have a chance to acquire an astral ship and become a true astral captain.
If you have 1500 gold coins, I will order a new ship to be built right away - the job will be done in 10 days. When the construction is complete, talk to ship master Nomarkh Hanotep in the astral hangar.
I won't be able to help you until your ship has been built.
Your ship's ready! A magnificent ship, the pride of the Imperial fleet! I believe a great future is in store for it!
Bring an Imperial Shipbuilder's License to Yaver Yevgini in the Nezebgrad Port to buy an Astral ship.
If you bring an Imperial Shipbuilder's License and 1500 gold to Yaver Yevgini in the Nezebgrad Port, you will receive a completed Astral Ship right away!
If you happen to find an Imperial Shipbuilder's License, I will give you a completed Astral ship right away!
Oh, my! I never thought I'd live to see the day when one of these would show up. Congratulations - now you can receive your Astral ship!
Take an Imperial Shipbuilder's License to Yaver Yevgini in the Nezebgrad Port and get an Astral ship.
If you bring an Imperial Shipbuilder's License to Yaver Yevgini in the Nezebgrad Port, you will receive a completed Astral Ship right away!
If you happen to find an Imperial Shipbuilder's License, I will give you a completed Astral ship right away!

Congratulations!
There are very few in the world as lucky as you.
Accept Yaver Yevgini's offer to start the construction.

What’s it going to be now? I can’t wait to get to the Far Astral! I wonder what goes on there, what monsters, what allods... New anomalies, unexplored lands! Damned Tep, why did he have to step out with his stupid mechanoids at this moment?

Haven’t you got an astral ship yet? Hurry to your Astral academy to see Yaver Yevgini. Both League and Empire decorated a whole allod with their ships’ wreckage, so all of us will have to create a new fleet! New ships, new crews, new captain... See which way the astral flee jumps? Right. So, the new ship is what you need, and all the Astral treasures are yours!
Alright, now we can begin building your ship. It will take us thirty three days to complete this on our own, but remember that you can always help us out.
Read fragments of Mark Staritsyn's chronicle of the last several years.

Oh, it's you! How do you do? Are you going to tell me something exciting? No? That's a shame. Frankly, I got used to strange things happening to you. Things that change the world! I feel so honored that you tell me everything! It makes me see things from a different prospective, which is very good for my job.

You see, I started writing a book. One may call it a scientific work. It is called "The Contemporary History of Sarnaut". It's a chronicle of all important events of the last years. I've got several chapters describing your adventures!

If you want, you can take a look at my drafts. Writing a book is not an easy thing to do!
I don't know what made me think I could carry out such an ambitious project. It will take me more than a lifetime to finish this book!

What? A typewriter? No, I don't think so. True inspiration only comes when you are holding a dip pen, and there is a blank sheet of paper and an inkpot on the desk in front of you. What if everyone starts using typewriters? What if some elven invention replaces books and paper? No, no, this is absolutely unacceptable.

Alright, thank you for your attention. You are obviously in a hurry, and I need to retreat to my solitude and a cup of fine coffee from Suslanger.

Tep, an Arisen from the Zem people, found a way to live forever by killing his own compatriots with a deadly plague and absorbing the power of their Sparks. The mightiest sorcerers joined their forces to repel the aggression of the Summoner and contaminated Tep with his own plague. Confined in his own Pyramid and sustained by his Sparks, the Summoner was doomed to thousands of years of dying and resurrecting again... His own genius condemned him to madness.

But several millennia later Tep Cultists found a way to release their master...
Accept the pieces of the Battleground Emblems from Natalya Zarnitsyna.

So, you're itching to knock somebody's lights out? I get it. I'm the same way! If I had the time, I'd be out on the battlefield myself... One sweep of the sword - the enemy falls! Pull out a crossbow - zap! Another one down! A third... Well, I'd have already run from the third one.
Anyway... Want to fight? I mean would you like to fight for a cause? I can help!
Take advantage of the Skirmishes menu and participate in a Battleground. If you don't know what the Battleground is, I'll tell you some other time. Don't interrupt me now.
I will give you some pieces of the Battleground Emblem. So you'd still be motivated to join in battle so as to find more pieces. When you've gathered enough pieces to assemble complete Emblems, come to me. I'll trade you valuable equipment for Emblems. That's fair, right? We, soldiers of fortune, are always ready for a good scrap. All the better if we can earn something valuable in exchange. You can't think of a better pastime!
Take these Emblem pieces. That's all you get! You're not the only one who needs them! If you run out, then you can get new pieces no earlier than next week.
Get a Right to Allowance from Natalya Zarnitsyna

What, itching to give someone a shiner? I get it. I'm the same! There was a time I fought on a battlefield... Brought one down with my sword. Another with my crossbow. A third one... I ran away from the third one, too.
What I'm saying is... Do you want to fight and benefit from it? I can help! I'll enter your name... How do you spell it...?
Ah, done! Now you're officially a participant of the Battleground! Whenever you want to fight, just search for Skirmishes. If you don't know what Battleground is, we'll tell you later. For now, just listen and don't interrupt.
Every week you will receive a Right to Allowance which you can exchange for gold. You can also earn Signs of Victory in every fight. As soon as you have 100 Signs, use them to combine them into Battleground Emblems. Once you have a lot of them, find me - I'll exchange the emblems for valuable items. Fair terms, don't you agree? We Soldiers of Fortune always enjoy a good fight. And if you can also get something valuable for that, all the better!
This is your Right to Allowance. That's all you're getting. Others need it, too! If you run out, you can get another next week.
Participate in Witch's Hollow and Deserted Farm battlegrounds, then report to Natalya Zarnitsyna in Nezebgrad.

Not only battlegrounds represent a great opportunity to prove that you are capable fighter - this is also a great way to obtain useful equipment. I can tell you more.
At the Witch's Hollow battleground your team must capture and hold key locations marked on the map. The more locations you control, the more points per second you are assigned. The first team to get 2500 points is the winner.
At the Deserted Farm the goal of your team is also to collect 2500 points, but there is only one key location in the middle of the battleground. June Bombards found by the team camps will help you to capture it.
All participants receive the reward according to their contribution. Pieces of Battleground Emblems are combined into the complete emblems that can be used to purchase equipment from Soldiers of Fortune's Quartermasters. If you are short of emblems, try visiting the junkmen - they sell the same items for a half price. The downside is that all their stuff is cursed.
I've seen bloody battles in my time...
Good job! Remember, you need to improve your reputation towards the Soldiers of Fortune by participating in battlegrounds and collecting Battleground Emblems.
Speak with Galewind the Wily in Yasker's Tower.

Attention, attention!
Hear Yasker's new order.
"The Imperial Army has long been proud of its skilled and disciplined soldiers. Now that there is a war raging furiously in the Holy Land, everyone capable of wielding a sword or using magic should devote their utmost attention to perfecting their combat skills.
The best Imperial trainers are willing to assist you with learning all of the techniques you need to know. Hurry and learn what you can!"
Did you hear that? Do you know what needs to be done? Good.
The warden trainer, Galewind the Wily, is waiting for you in Yasker's Tower. She'll share her knowledge of nature's power and teach you to use it for the good of the Empire!
Do you want to train? I can teach you how to harness the power of nature itself.
Speak with Wit Sen in Yasker's Tower.

Attention, attention!
Hear Yasker's new order.
"The Imperial Army has long been proud of its skilled and disciplined soldiers. Now that there is a war raging furiously in the Holy Land, everyone capable of wielding a sword or using magic should devote their utmost attention to perfecting their combat skills.
The best Imperial trainers are willing to assist you with learning all of the techniques you need to know. Hurry and learn what you can!"
Did you hear that? Do you know what needs to be done? Good.
The engineer trainer, Wit Sen, is waiting for you in Yasker's Tower. He is believed to have been born with a screwdriver in his hands! He can teach you lots of stuff. Good luck!
Do you want to train? I can teach you how to harness the mechanics!
Speak with Stas Honorin in Yasker's Tower.

Attention, attention!
Hear Yasker's new order.
"The Imperial Army has long been proud of its skilled and disciplined soldiers. Now that there is a war raging furiously in the Holy Land, everyone capable of wielding a sword or using magic should devote their utmost attention to perfecting their combat skills.
The best Imperial trainers are willing to assist you with learning all of the techniques you need to know. Hurry and learn what you can!"
Did you hear that? Do you know what needs to be done? Good.
The paladin trainer, Stas Honorin, is waiting for you in Yasker's Tower. Speak with him and learn the secrets of the Light. Do that and you'll be able to show those Kanians the error of their ways. Good luck!

Pleased to meet you! I'd be happy to help you train. The more Imperial paladins there are, the faster we'll defeat the League!
In the name of the Light!
Talk with the bard trainer Yulia Garmoshkina near Yasker's tower.

Attention!
Yasker's latest order!
"The Imperial army has long taken pride in its capable and well-trained soldiers. And now, with the battle for the Holy Land in full swing, everyone who can carry a weapon in their fist or a spell on their lips should spend all their time developing their combat skills. The best of the Empire's trainers are prepared to meet with you and help you acquire the fundamentals of your craft! Hurry to complete your studies!"
Ugh. Were you paying attention? Do you know what to do? Good.
The bard trainer, Yulia Garmoshkina, is waiting for you near Yasker's Tower. Now there's someone who knows a song or two! Have a talk with her. You'll learn a great deal of the professional secrets of the wandering musician. Onward!

Hey there! I see you're on your way to joining the caterwaulers? That's great! Us bards, we're not as handy with weapons or all that death-dealing magic, but you'd be nowhere without our music. We'll play upbeat songs at celebrations, or during down time we'll accompany the lads on guitars while they sing morale-raising patriotic songs... You should never underestimate the power of art!
Speak with Wit Sen in Yasker's Tower.

Attention, attention!
Hear Yasker's new order.
"The Imperial Army has long been proud of its skilled and disciplined soldiers. Now that there is a war raging furiously in the Holy Land, everyone capable of wielding a sword or using magic should devote their utmost attention to perfecting their combat skills.
The best Imperial trainers are willing to assist you with learning all of the techniques you need to know. Hurry and learn what you can!"
Did you hear that? Do you know what needs to be done? Good.
The engineer trainer, Wit Sen, is waiting for you in Yasker's Tower. He is believed to have been born with a screwdriver in his hands! He can teach you lots of stuff. Good luck!

Hand me a box end wrench and a lock bolt, will you?
I can see you're on close terms with the tools! Can you tell the difference between a driveshaft and a crankshaft? That's good. We engineers need to look deep into it.
Speak with Semer Ramaz in Yasker's Tower.

Attention, attention!
Hear Yasker's new order.
"The Imperial Army has long been proud of its skilled and disciplined soldiers. Now that there is a war raging furiously in the Holy Land, everyone capable of wielding a sword or using magic should devote their utmost attention to perfecting their combat skills.
The best Imperial trainers are willing to assist you with learning all of the techniques you need to know. Hurry and learn what you can!"
Did you hear that? Do you know what needs to be done? Good.
The mage trainer, Semer Ramaz, is waiting for you in Yasker's Tower. He can teach you how to harness the elements and control their destructive power. Good luck!

Greetings. The mastery of elemental magic was perfected long ago by the first of the Great Mages. You are just beginning your journey in mastering these forces, and I will help you take your first steps.
Speak with Sarbaz Veeda in Yasker's Tower.

Attention, attention!
Hear Yasker's new order.
"The Imperial Army has long been proud of its skilled and disciplined soldiers. Now that there is a war raging furiously in the Holy Land, everyone capable of wielding a sword or using magic should devote their utmost attention to perfecting their combat skills.
The best Imperial trainers are willing to assist you with learning all of the techniques you need to know. Hurry and learn what you can!"
Did you hear that? Do you know what needs to be done? Good.
The summoner trainer, Sarbaz Veeda, is waiting for you in Yasker's Tower. He'll help you learn how to summon undead servants and heal your friends with your enemies' energy. Good luck!

There are many who think that summoning guarantees an easy victory. Ha!
There are few who can actually be considered skilled summoners. When you complete your studies with me, you'll be able to fight for the right to become one of them.
Speak with Timur Svetin in Yasker's Tower.

Attention, attention!
Hear Yasker's new order.
"The Imperial Army has long been proud of its skilled and disciplined soldiers. Now that there is a war raging furiously in the Holy Land, everyone capable of wielding a sword or using magic should devote their utmost attention to perfecting their combat skills.
The best Imperial trainers are willing to assist you with learning all of the techniques you need to know. Hurry and learn what you can!"
Did you hear that? Do you know what needs to be done? Good.
The priest trainer, Timur Svetin, is waiting for you in Yasker's Tower. Talk to him and learn how to heal your allies and punish your enemies. You are a beacon of hope to the Imperial Army, so work hard and learn well!
Is there room in your heart for compassion? Is there room in your heart for mercilessness? If so, than you can be a healer. I'll help you with your studies.
Speak with Gella Rozanova in Yasker's Tower.

Attention, attention!
Hear Yasker's new order.
"The Imperial Army has long been proud of its skilled and disciplined soldiers. Now that there is a war raging furiously in the Holy Land, everyone capable of wielding a sword or using magic should devote their utmost attention to perfecting their combat skills.
The best Imperial trainers are willing to assist you with learning all of the techniques you need to know. Hurry and learn what you can!"
Did you hear that? Do you know what needs to be done? Good.
The psionicist trainer, Gella Rozanova, is waiting for you in Yasker's Tower. Talk to her to learn about the intricacies of mind controlling. Go!

You don't have to say anything. I don't need to know how to read minds here to understand why you've come.
You want to study. That's good. Knowledge is power! Especially the knowledge of your enemy's weaknesses, hehe.
Speak with Spike the Nimble in Yasker's Tower.

Attention, attention!
Hear Yasker's new order.
"The Imperial Army has long been proud of its skilled and disciplined soldiers. Now that there is a war raging furiously in the Holy Land, everyone capable of wielding a sword or using magic should devote their utmost attention to perfecting their combat skills.
The best Imperial trainers are willing to assist you with learning all of the techniques you need to know. Hurry and learn what you can!"
Did you hear that? Do you know what needs to be done? Good.
The scout trainer, Spike the Nimble, is waiting for you in Yasker's Tower. You'll learn the art of camouflage, how to charm arrows, and how to deliver deadly blows. Study well!

You know what I keep thinking about? How long it would take me kill one of these pompous Hawks.
Not very long I'd guess. What that really means is that if you want to learn how to kill, you're in the right place!
Speak with Sledge the Rowdy in Yasker's Tower.

Attention, attention!
Hear Yasker's new order.
"The Imperial Army has long been proud of its skilled and disciplined soldiers. Now that there is a war raging furiously in the Holy Land, everyone capable of wielding a sword or using magic should devote their utmost attention to perfecting their combat skills.
The best Imperial trainers are willing to assist you with learning all of the techniques you need to know. Hurry and learn what you can!"
Did you hear that? Do you know what needs to be done? Good.
The warrior trainer, Sledge the Rowdy, is waiting for you in Yasker's Tower. She'll show you how to hold your weapon straight and deliver mighty blows. Enjoy!

What are you staring at? Do you have a problem with a female warrior? If I had one gold for every stupid man who tried to show me how strong he was, I'd have a mountain taller than this tower!
Alright, don't get scared! Let's be friends. I'll tell you all about the art of being a true warrior. And the first secret I'll tell you is this - there's none stronger than us!
Open the Gift Chest and talk to the Keeper of Secrets.
I have something to reward you. This ancient chest contains potent magic. I hope you like it!
You don't look happy with your reward. What happened?

Well...
It's not just what we've expected.
It's ok, this example will help me teach you a more important thing.
Take this coupon and exchange it for a free Scroll of Purification in the Boutique.
With the help of Scroll of Purification wave the Curse from a cursed stash. Report to the Keeper of Secrets Mark Staritsin.

Tensess' Gift which gives us some kind of immortality, didn't come easy to the world.
To override the power of Tep's Pyramid where Tensess Spark can be obtained now, Great Mage of Kania had to fight with Tep himself. Tep failed, however, he managed to do a bad turn to all of us. Many valuable things become cursed. They give no advantages. Quite the contrary! They spoil your abilities, if you put on such cursed item.
So I have a cursed Grubby Belt instead of a good one. Don't worry! We can deal with it all right. The coupon that I've given to you can be exchanged for the Scroll of Purification that may take away the curse. Try and check it.
Did you manage to lift the Curse?

Perfect!
Now you know how to deal with a curse.
All you need is Scroll of Purification. Use it and enjoy your new toy .
By studying the past we can shape our future. That is why my work is so important. By helping me to uncover the world's mysteries, you are helping the Empire!
Bring the Fifth Page from the Great Mage's Diary to Goblin Banker in the Boutique at the bank of your faction's capital.
Goblin Banker will certainly be interested in this document.

What unbelievable luck! The Great Mage's Diary has been discovered!
Don't you know who the Great Mage was? It can't be true! Even Goblins know who the Great Mage is! He is a great hero of the past!
In the year 646 of the New Era he solved the mystery of Umoir and helped Skrakan defeat the great demon! See?
For years the diary was thought to be lost. And then this great news arrive! Unfortunately, the adventurers who found it didn't understand the true value of the document. Fools... They thought these papers were just dusty scrolls worth a couple of gold coins... But it is a priceless rarity! Oh, I wish I could have it...
I know that merchants put pages from the diary into Strongboxes of the Counselor. There are plenty of them! Anyone can buy them from the Boutique. I'm sure there's no way to find all the pages.
Oh, I wish someone would bring me just one page! I would be so grateful!
Word of an honest goblin!
What an excellent find! The Great Mage's diary is of national importance. For this information you deserve a hefty reward.
Bring 22 different class capes to Valentin Rubashkin in Nezebgrad.

I'm working on an important order - I must create a new uniform for our glorious army! Yasker personally asked me to make it convenient but keep the heroic appearance. And of course, it must be stylish and fashionable. Nobody will respect a soldier dressed in grandfather rags!
Are you interested in the designer's job? I could use your help. I need to compare the designs of different capes. Do you know the Cloak Chests? Bring me all 28 capes from the Chests. You can buy them from the Boutique, trade with someone or find them on the auction...
I hope a unique cape sewn by famous Valentin Rubashkin will be a perfect reward for you!
I'm putting a special spell on you, so you can easily see which cape I need.
I'm putting a special spell on you, so you can see which cape I need. Bring me the one I need right now, I won't accept any other!

You managed to find all capes! The new uniform is nearly done. When our soldiers step on the battlefield in their new overcoats with gold laces and braids, the enemy will go blind from our awesomeness!
Bring 28 different class costumes to Valentin Rubashkin in Nezebgrad.

I'm working on an important order - I must create a new uniform for our glorious army! Yasker personally asked me to make it convenient but keep the heroic appearance. And of course, it must be stylish and fashionable. Nobody will respect a soldier dressed in grandfather rags!
Are you interested in the designer's job? I could use your help. I need to compare the designs of different uniforms. Have you seen the Costume Chests sold in the Boutique? Bring me all 28 costumes from those Chests. You can buy them from the Boutique, trade with someone or find them on the auction...
I hope a unique costume sewn by the famous Valentin Rubashkin will be a perfect reward for you!
I'm putting a special spell on you, so you can easily see which costume I need.
I'm putting a special spell on you, so you can see which costume I need. Bring me the one I need right now, I won't accept any other!

Bring 28 different class headpieces to Valentin Rubashkin in Nezebgrad.

Are you interested in the designer's job? I could use your help. I need to compare the designs of different headpieces. Do you know the Headgear Chests sold in the Boutique? Bring me all 28 headpieces from the Chests. You can buy them from the Boutique, trade with someone or find them on the auction...
I hope a unique headpiece sewn by the famous Valentin Rubashkin will be a perfect reward for you!
I'm putting a special spell on you, so you can easily see which headpiece I need.
I'm putting a special spell on you, so you can see which headpiece I need. Bring me the one I need right now, I won't accept any other!

You managed to find all 28 headpieces! The new uniform is nearly done. When our soldiers step on the battlefield in their new overcoats with gold laces and braids, the enemy will go blind from our awesomeness!
Hang 3 Orcish Flags on the advertising pillars surrounding Yasker's Tower. Report to Wrokag the Northwind when you are done.

What do you know about Goblinball?
Only a little? Well it just so happens to be the national sport of the Orcs!
I won't lie - all these new-fangled things aren't for me. The Orcs have to hold on to their roots! And traditions! But you can't stand in the way of progress I suppose.
There's going to be a Goblinball championship soon. A new stadium is under construction on the Wild Isles. The shaman team is playing. I'm sure they'll win! But we'll talk about that later. It can wait.
Right now I've got a task for you to do. We've got to prepare the whole Empire for the upcoming championship. That's why I'm asking you to hang these Orcish flags. There are advertising pillars around Yasker's Tower. You can hang the flags on them. Here are three flags. Hang them and come back here. Get going!
Let the flags fly from every corner! Let the Empire remember whose blood has purchased our victory!
Good job! I'm sure there will be a huge turnout at the Championship this year.
Hang 3 Orcish Flags on the advertising pillars surrounding Yasker's Tower. Report to Wrokag the Northwind when you are done.

I won't lie - all these new-fangled things aren't for me. The Orcs have to hold on to their roots! And traditions! But you can't stand in the way of progress I suppose.

Here are three flags. Hang them and come back here. Get going!
Let the flags fly from every corner! Let the Empire remember whose blood has purchased our victory!

Good job!

I'm sure there will be a huge turnout at the Championship this year.
Open the Container of Sparks at the Nezebgrad Port and return to Negus Kheket.

Do you know what happiness is? Can you enjoy the life granted to you after death?
These questions aren't empty words. Most of the Arisen consider their rebirth to be normal. But that isn't so! Blind luck allowed us to be resurrected! How many of the Zem people still remain dead today? Have you ever stopped to consider it?
A Zem burial ground has recently been discovered that contains millions of sparks. Sparks are the souls of the Zem that have yet to become Arisen. Unfortunately, most of the land belonging to the burial grounds has been destroyed by the Astral. That means there's little hope that the sparks can return to their bodies, for their bodies have probably been destroyed as well.
Here, take this. This container contains dozens of sparks. They are unlikely to be resurrected, but what we can do for them is to give them eternal peace.
Head to the Nezebgrad Port. You'll find some Zem ruins there where you can spread these lost sparks. They will be consumed by the Astral and given the gift of a final death. That's the right thing to do.
Go now and remember that your life after death should not be taken for granted!

Go now and remember that your life after death should not be taken for granted!

I hope this has been a valuable experience for you. Some think about the inevitability of death, others think about the value of life. But the most important thing is that they THINK! That's what makes us different from the mindless undead, and that's why thinking is our main duty!

That's the right thing to do.

Go now and remember that your life after death should not be taken for granted!

Speak at the demonstration at Victory Park using the papers you received and report to Elizaveta Rysina when you are done.

I have a mission of national importance. Listen well!

We have recently discovered that there is no unity within the Kanian Church of Light! A report from our agents indicates that a Kanian priest known as Chayan Khrabrov has proposed declaring Nezeb and Skrakan as saints of equal importance as Tensess. That means that he has declared the postulates of his church wrong, and accepted our Trinity Church as the only true one. It's nice to know that there are sensible people among the Kanians.

However, his proposal was rejected by the leaders of the Church of Light. In response, Chayan Khrabrov began a hunger strike to protest their decision. Stories about the heroic actions of this Kanian will appear in our newspapers today. However, that is not enough! It is essential that all Imperial Citizens be reminded of the superiority of the Trinity Church!

You are the Imperial survivor. That means that it is your responsibility to spread the word.

Take this. This is the speech you must give at the demonstration in support of Chayan Khrabrov's hunger strike. It will take place in Victory Park.

Remember, this is your duty! You of all people should know that weapons aren't the only way to hurt the enemy!

I'm not sure that one demonstration is enough! We should organize them on all Imperial allods!

We also need to collect food and warm clothes for that priest. On second thought, no food. He is on a hunger strike!

I have already heard how your speech was a resounding success among the citizens of Nezebgrad. You see, sometimes the pen is mightier than the sword, and this was one of those times!

As a reward, I shall instruct you in an ability that is only taught to the most trusted Imperial citizens. Thank you for serving the Empire on this day!

So... Zimina's clone, who possesses all her skills and memories, is walking around Ferris, threating the expedition and trying to reach some ancient device, for which the Empire once performed miracles of conspiracy? That's just great.

Zimina is right - it's about time we interfered. I will prepare a team of our best fighters and specialists. While I am working on that, you have to reconfigure the portal system on Ferris to let us teleport directly to you. Just don't let the Historians see it.

Is your mission clear? Go back. Let's not waste a minute!
Speak to Inga Polkina at the Old Square to learn to dance.

Wait a minute! Can you dance? No, I don't mean your one-two-three-step, I mean something more sophisticated. If you cannot, run to the Old Square to take a dancing lesson that Inga Polkina is giving! Hurry, before she leaves the city!
Step-step-triple-step... Don't be shy, join us! It's easy, see?
Now you will remember the steps forever! Isn't it great?
Bring 5 Anniversary Copper Coins to Vladimir Jubilein.

Happy holiday!
It's been a year since Yasker issued a decree to recruit more heroes to the Empire ranks. Copper, silver, gold and platinum commemorative coins were minted in celebration of this glorious event. You can occasionally loot them among your trophies.
Bring them to me, and I'll reward you generously! For example, I can trade 5 copper coins for 3 small gifts.
I sell various goods for the commemorative coins.

Here are the coins... And the gifts!
Happy holiday!
Bring 3 Anniversary Silver Coins to Vladimir Jubilein.

Happy holidays!
What do you mean which holiday? Exactly one year has passed since the momentous moment when Yasker signed the decree "Mass Draft of Imperial Recruits." Quite a few glorious heroes have appeared in Nezebgrad since then. True heroes! True victors! It was thanks to their achievements that the League was crushed and the demon threat repelled. What a wise and timely decree it turned out to be!
And to celebrate the anniversary, many commemorative coins of different denominations were issued. Copper, silver, gold and platinum.
Obviously, copper coins are the most common of the four, while the platinum are the most rare.
Coins can be found anywhere. You are even sure to get coins as a trophy when battling enemies.
After you acquire a coin, be sure to turn it into "Value," which will transform it from a useless knickknack into a valuable item that you can then use to buy something from me.
For instance, I'll trade you 2 Medium Gifts for 3 commemorative silver coins!
I sell various goods for the commemorative coins.

Here are the coins... And the gifts!
Happy holiday!
Bring 1 Anniversary Gold Coin to Vladimir Jubilein.

Receive the Right Halves of the Contest Medal from Spin the Reckless in Nezebgrad.

Do you want to participate in goblinball? I will give you a few Right Halves of the Contest Medal. For each completed game, you will receive a certain amount of the Signs of the Athlete. A hundred of these signs can be traded for the Left Half of the Contest Medal, and two different halves can be combined into an intact medal.
Ole, ole-ole-ole! The Empire is the champion!
Receive parts of Contest Medal at Spin the Reckless in Nezebgrad.

Listen up! Have you heard about golblinball? It's a tough sport for tough heroes. Fast and furious, not just your ordinary game for children. It's deadly serious, and we even hold championships with prizes!

Do you want to participate?
I will give you a few Right Halves of the Contest Medal. For each completed game, you will receive a certain amount of the Signs of the Athlete. A hundred of these signs can be traded for the Left Half of the Contest Medal, and two different halves can be combined into an intact medal. Go-go, champion!
Ole, ole-ole-ole! The Empire is the champion!
Receive tickets to Goblinball Championship from Net the Reckless.

Are you in for sports? Do you like to kick a goblin sometimes? Or are you just about to kick the bucket? I've seen them heroes weak as a fly! I hope you're not like this, you're strong, and keen, and sporty! This is just what we need!

We're in the middle of Sarnaut Cup Goblinball Championship, and we are looking for players! Whole teams of goblinball players! Are you strong enough to stand up for the Empire? Here are the tickets. Four a week, no more. If it's not enough, use your chance to play practice games. You don't get any rewards or prizes for it, though, but you can play as many games as you need.
Here you go. Now gather your team and sign up for the competition. I'll cheer well for you!
Praise your guild at the three denoted locations and report back to Semer Khendjer.

Do you want to prove your loyalty and earn a great Prestige?
It has never been easier! This Pledge gives you an opportunity to glorify your guild all over Nezebgrad. Take these three speeches. You should deliver them at the Bort Quarter, at the Old Square, and in the Victory Park.
Please note that people listen to Great Heroes more willingly. This means that a Great Hero's speech will bring greater prestige to the guild.
Complete the Pledge quests to earn Prestige and prove your loyalty to the guild.
You have fulfilled your duty. Your loyalty is beyond any doubt!
Kill 20 Disciples of Tep in the Ruined Catacombs and report to Semer Khendjer.

Do you want to prove your loyalty and earn a great Prestige?
Here is the Pledge for you: kill 20 Disciples of Tep at the Ruined Catacombs of Nezebgrad. Those renegades deserve to die, and there is no better way to glorify your guild than to discipline them.
Kill 20 demons on Kirah and report to Semer Khendjer.

Do you want to prove your loyalty to the guild and gain prestige?
Fighting demons is a rightful duty of every citizen. Beat them until they return to the darkness where they belong!
Kill 20 demons on Kirah to complete your pledge.
Kill 20 Deadmen on the Isle of Revelation and talk to Guild Master Semer Khendjer.

Do you want to prove your loyalty and earn more Prestige?
I can help you.
Here is the vow you need to take: defeat 20 Deadmen on the Isle of Revelation. Deadmen must be lying in the ground... not wandering the allods!
If you cope can with them, you will have stayed true to your vow.
Go now!
Kill 20 Cultists on the Frozen Peak and report to Semer Khendjer.

Do you want to prove your loyalty and earn a great Prestige?
Here is the Pledge for you: kill 20 Tep Cultists on the Frozen Peak. Those renegades deserve to die, and there is no better way to glorify your guild than to discipline them.
Kill 10 Draconids and 10 Wormfaces at the Frontier and report to Semer Khendjer.

Do you want to prove loyalty and earn prestige?
I can help you out.
Kill 10 Draconids and 10 Wormfaces at the Frontier. They betrayed us, and it was their death sentence.
Kill 20 pagan aviaks on the Windy Hills and report to Guild Master Semer Khendjer.

Do you want to prove your loyalty and earn Prestige? I can help you with that.
Here is the pledge for you: destroy 20 pagan aviaks that live on the Windy Hills in Irdrich. Those ignorant heretics are incapable of seeing the power of the Light. If their sordid existence in dark superstitions isn't enough to make them accept a life in the Light, maybe the threat of death will!
If you can do it, the pledge will be completed.
Kill 20 Outlaws near Lower City and report to Guild Master Semer Khendjer.

Do you want to prove your loyalty to the guild and gain prestige?

Fighting demons is a rightful duty of every citizen. Beat them until they return to the darkness where they belong!

Kill 20 Outlaws near Lower City to complete your pledge.
Kill 20 Werefoxes near the lake and report to Guild Master Semer Khendjer.

Do you want to prove your loyalty to the guild and gain prestige? Fighting monsters is a rightful duty of every citizen. Beat them until they return to the darkness where they belong! Kill 20 werefoxes at Umoir to complete your pledge.
Kill 20 League Champions and Surveyors at Medial Plateau in Kingdom of Elements and report to Guild Master Semer Khendjer.

Do you want to prove your loyalty to the guild and gain prestige?
Kill 20 League Champions and Surveyors at Medial Plateau in Kingdom of Elements.
This will complete your pledge.
Kill 20 Living Ice shards near the Ice Cave on Ferris and report to Guild Master Semer Khendjer.

Do you want to prove your loyalty and gain prestige? I can help you with that.
Here is what you need to do: kill 20 Living Ice shards in the icy plains of Ferris. The Surveyors will be very grateful to you!
If you do that, consider your pledge completed.
Kill 20 trolls in the Shore City vicinity on Dane and report to Guild Master Semer Khendjer.

Do you want to prove your loyalty to the guild and gain prestige?

Here is the pledge: you need to kill 20 dumb trolls on Dane. They are harming the local citizens, and you would really do them a favor if you reduce the population of the beasts.

If you do that, your pledge will be fulfilled.
Kill 20 termites at the Old Barracks and report to Semer Khendjer.

Do you want to prove your loyalty and earn a great Prestige?
Here is the Pledge for you: kill 20 Termites at the Old Barracks. Military command is willing to retrieve the army property invaded by these creatures. Do if for the glory of your guild!
Kill 20 Goblins at the Northern Sand Bar by the Dead Sea and report to Semer Khendjer.

Do you want to prove your loyalty and earn a great Prestige?
Here is the Pledge for you: kill 20 goblins at the Northern Sand Bar by the Dead Sea. They have formed a gang there, a criminal conspiracy. If you punish them, this will glorify your guild.
Kill 20 banshees in Uskul the Dead City and report to Semer Khendjer.

Do you want to prove your loyalty and earn a great Prestige?
Here is the Pledge for you: kill 20 banshees in Uskul the Dead City on Asee-Teph. Historians who work there asked for our help. Do it for the glory of your guild!
Kill 20 Demonic Cultists of Asee-Teph and report to Semer Khendjer.

Do you want to prove your loyalty and earn a great Prestige?
Here is the Pledge for you: kill 20 Demonic Cultists on Asee-Teph. This scum must be destroyed on sight! Since you have such a wonderful opportunity, use it to glorify your guild.
Kill 20 Goblin Corsairs at the Takalik Harbor and report to Semer Khendjer.

Do you want to prove your loyalty and earn a great Prestige?
Here is the Pledge for you: kill 20 Goblin Corsairs landed at the Takalik Harbor on Eljune. Local Free Traders asked for our help. Do it for the glory of your guild!
Kill 20 Tep Cultists on Coba Plateau and report to Semer Khendjer.

Do you want to prove your loyalty and earn a great Prestige?
Here is the Pledge for you: kill 20 Tep Cultists spotted in Coba Plateau. Fighting them is the duty of every citizen of the Empire! And if your guild requires more Prestige, this is your chance to help.
Kill 20 Black Dragons on Yazes Shard and report to Semer Khendjer.

Do you want to prove your loyalty and earn a great Prestige?
Here is the Pledge for you: kill 20 Black Dragons on Yazes Shard. These creatures are dangerous and unpredictable. Great Mages are fighting their leaders, the Great Dragons, for a long time...
Excuse me, I'm running ahead of myself. Yasker's note says that only the most trusted people can are allowed to Yazes Shard. Make sure you understand how dangerous this mission is before taking this Pledge.
Kill 20 Demons in Gipat Caves and report to Semer Khendjer.

Do you want to prove your loyalty and earn a great Prestige?
Here is the Pledge for you: kill 20 Demons in Gipat Caves. Every citizen of the Empire should fight the demons, even on territories beyond our control.
Throw the Challenging Gauntlet on the pavement of Nezebgrad to summon the Shadow Foe, defeat him and report to Semer Khendjer.

Do you want to prove your loyalty and earn a great Prestige?
You can do so by defeating a dangerous enemy that embodies all the bad things that can happen in your guild. Mutiny, fights, intrigues... We are humans after all... Well, not counting for orcs.
I will give you the Challenging Gauntlet. By throwing it on the Nezebgrad pavement you will shift to another plane of our realm, where you will have to face your Shadow Foe and defeat it.
Complete the Pledge quests to earn Prestige and prove your loyalty to the guild.
You have fulfilled your duty. Your loyalty is beyond any doubt!
Obtain 50 Marks of Diligence by fighting your enemies and report to Semer Khendjer.

Do you want to prove your loyalty and earn a great Prestige?
Then you will have to show your persistence and fervor. You can get a special trophy from the enemies you will face during your journeys, it is called a Mark of Diligence. Collect 50 such Marks and bring them to me. Remember: you will not receive any Marks fighting weaker enemies.
Complete the Pledge quests to earn Prestige and prove your loyalty to the guild.
You have fulfilled your duty. Your loyalty is beyond any doubt!
Kill 20 sermoners of the Church of Light in the Misty Hollow on Irdrich and report to Guild Registrar Semer Khendjer.

Do you want to prove your loyalty and earn prestige?
I can help you with this.
Here's the pledge for you: destroy 20 sermoners of the Church of Light, which have been subverting the minds of our potential aviak allies in the Windy Hills. Naive locals are simple and trusting... the League preachers will easily subvert them with their boring sermons. Rescuing them from their priestly influence and putting them on the true path to the Light is your righteous duty!
Do this to complete your pledge.
Bring a Symbol of the Herald, a Symbol of the Punisher, a Symbol of the Duelist, and a Symbol of the Fervor to Semer Khendjer.

Complete Pledges to receive special symbols. Keep them in a safe place!

If you manage to complete four Pledges in one day, your efforts for the cause of your guild will be noted! Besides, your services will help your guild reset the Rubies that have already been studied.

Remember, within one day you must complete the following quests: the Pledge of Eulogy, the Pledge of Punishment, the Pledge of Dueling, and the Pledge of Fervor. Bring me a Symbol of the Herald, a Symbol of the Punisher, a Symbol the Duelist, and a Symbol of the Fervor to ensure that your merits will be remembered!
Encouraging the most diligent people makes a good example for the others.
Your diligence will not pass unnoticed! Praised be your guild!

Comrade, stop and listen! The times are hard for the Empire. We're sending our troops out to all the corners of Sarnaut to fight the threat of the League, Astral demons, and Nezeb knows what else. Alas, not every soldier is able to return home safe and sound.

Their widows and orphans stay with no support. By Yasker's highest order, all families of the fallen soldiers must receive compensation. So now we are raising funds and seeking charity in different guilds. You may volunteer to donate, in order to help the widows and bring glory to your guild.

All you have to do is to buy a Symbol of Mercy from me. I am redirecting all funds to families of the fallen.
The Empire never lets its citizens down! That's our key difference from the League, where everyone has to stand for themselves.
I officially thank you on behalf of the Empire! Your contribution is a way more important than you might think. You are welcome to make it again and again.
I will explain you everything you should know about guilds.
Fine, now you know everything. Feel free to join any guild - I'm sure I won't be ashamed for you!
Agree with Guild Master Semer Khendjer to get a Blessed Rune.

As far as you know, now due to new achievements in the sphere of ritual magic, it is much easier to get a new level of Patronage. No need to obtain a Blessed Rune.
However, there are those who managed to get Patronage by old methods. By Yasker's order I must return a Blessed Rune to those who found themselves in such situation.
You'd better not throw it away. Free Trader Vlad Astralin arrived in the Nezebgrad Port and exchanges Blessed Runes for Sacred Rune, which hasn't lost its value.
So, do you want to get a Blessed Rune?

Excellent.
Here is your Rune. Good luck.
Bring the Universal Device to Goblin Banker at the Boutique Headquarters.
This device looks extremely complicated and rare. Obviously, someone of a very sharp mind has crafted it. It has to be really valuable. Better Talk to Goblin Banker.
Good afternoon! How can I help you?

What’s that? Let me see. A manabike combined with a... bicycle?!

You are a lucky one. It’s a universal device. It won’t make you coffee, but it can serve as a reactor or as a motor, if you apply it to a ship. What do you need more? Choose!

Bring the Shipyard Certificate to Goblin Banker at the Boutique Headquarters.

The certificate is adorned with dozen stamps, including stamps of the ship-repairing yard and Goblin Banker himself. It reads that the bearer of the document can use the services of most experienced shipwrights, who can turn a frail boat into an unsinkable Corvette. You should show the paper to Goblin Banker!
Good afternoon! How can I help you?

Ah, a certificate! The seal is genuine, and here is my signature. Alright, do you want more cannons, or thicker armor? If you want five cannons on the boards and two at the stern, we can make you a Corvette. If you want it as solid as a rock, we will use reinforced armor. It's up to you!
Collect 5 Broken Runes and deliver them to Semer Nemar.
Restoring the runes is easy. Trekking all over Nezebgrad is the hard part!
Bring the Replica of a Page of the Carnifex Code to Goblin Banker at the Boutique Headquarters of your faction's capital.
Written in scarlet letters on sheets of ancient parchment. Is this really ink?.. Show this page to Goblin Banker.
The Carnifex Code reveals many dark secrets! Just one page of it will enable you to steal the life force of the enemies that you kill to heal your wounds.
Talk to Elizaveta Rysina to pledge your loyalty to the Trinity Church and receive your martyr's blessing.

Hold on! Look into my eyes and answer me truthfully. Do you believe in the sacrifices of Tensess, Skrakan, and Nezeb? Do you follow the testament of the Trinity Church? Are you loyal to Yasker's Holy Principles?
These are not pointless questions. I can help all citizens that are faithful by asking their martyr to give them a special blessing. Now, to answer my questions. I strongly advise against lying. Well, what is your answer?

Here is your blessing.
May the Light guide you!
